title: LAPS is not backing up to Entra ID, or passwords rotate too slowly

maxAgeDays.text: Days before the local administrator password is rotated

report.title: {Items.Count} LAPS {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy is', 'policies are')} not configured as recommended

messages.businessImpact: Either the passwords are not being stored anywhere administrators can retrieve them, or they stay valid long enough for a recovered password to remain useful.
remediation: Set the backup directory to Entra ID and the password age to 30 days or fewer.
Enable rotation after the password has been retrieved.
